protocol.confidenceIntervals: Wilson 95% for per-controller completion; conservative Bonferroni Wilson difference intervals for paired completion rates; Student-t mean intervals with a Cornish-Fisher t-quantile approximation for per-controller continuous metrics; seeded percentile bootstrap of paired scenario differences for continuous controller deltas.

confidenceLimitations: Intervals describe variability across the fixed generated scenario sample, conditional on these circuits and saved networks. Scenarios are paired between controllers; each circuit has a separate seeded stratified sample. Steering episodes are a shared comparator across saved network seeds, and the same networks are evaluated on all circuits. The three circuits and three trained networks are not independent population samples.

pairedAgainstSteering.interpretation: Neural minus Steering; percentile bootstrap resamples matched scenario pairs.

completionRate.intervalMethod: Conservative Bonferroni difference of marginal 97.5% Wilson score intervals; valid under paired dependence.
